service.name: Snaprint
service.category: Self-service print kiosk hardware and software
service.description: Snaprint turns xerox/photocopy shops into 24/7 self-service print kiosks. Customers scan a QR code, upload a document, pay, and collect the print — no queue, no shop owner needed to operate it.
capabilities: Accepts document uploads via QR code scan
Prints via any connected printer brand (Canon, HP, Epson, Brother)
Operates unattended, including outside shop hours
Live order, revenue, and consumables dashboard for shop owners
Encrypts uploaded files and deletes them after each print job
